summary: Backend-only testing of new v1.1 Drafts feature against LIVE Firestore via public URL. 5/5 pytest cases passed: create order draft with data round-trip, list filter by kind (order vs historical_invoice isolation), PUT update (label+data+updated_at), historical_invoice CRUD, DELETE + 404 on missing id. All created drafts were removed; a post-run GET /api/drafts returned 0 records so no live-data pollution.

minor.issue: Empty dict data replaces stored data because route uses `data.data or {}` (falsy check). Sending {"data": {}} on update wipes existing data even when caller intends an empty payload — but sending explicit empty is same-outcome so low impact. Consider `data.data if data.data is not None else {}`.

Payload requires `kind` (DraftIn is not partial) but update handler never actually applies `data.kind` — kind cannot be changed via PUT. Documented behaviour but the required field is misleading; either make kind optional or apply it.

action_items: Consider fixing `data.data or {}` -> `data.data if data.data is not None else {}` in POST/PUT to avoid clobbering with empty dicts (minor).
Either honor `kind` on PUT or make it optional in DraftIn for update to reduce API confusion (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/drafts.py: `label` and `data` use `or` fallbacks which conflate falsy values with 'not provided'. Prefer explicit None checks so callers can intentionally set label='' or data={}.

routes/drafts.py list_drafts sort uses updated_at as ISO string — works because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically, but only for UTC timestamps with fixed format. Consider storing as datetime or documenting the invariant.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED test drafts inline. Order draft id and historical_invoice draft id both cleaned up. Post-run GET /api/drafts returned 0 drafts.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 via Firebase REST (id token as Bearer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend hot-reload is enabled and watches /app/backend recursively including /app/backend/tests — creating/editing a test file mid-run triggers a uvicorn reload and can cause a 502/read-timeout on the first in-flight request. Workaround: create/save test files first, then wait ~5s (or `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) before running pytest. Drafts feature is functional; only minor semantic concerns noted.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial two test runs failed with read timeout on POST /api/drafts. Root cause: WatchFiles reloader inside uvicorn detected the newly-written /app/backend/tests/test_drafts.py and initiated a shutdown that waited on in-flight background tasks; the first POST hit during that window returned 502 via Cloudflare. Confirmed via /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log 'WatchFiles detected changes in tests/test_drafts.py. Reloading...' and 'Waiting for background tasks to complete'. After `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and re-running, all 5 tests passed in 9.49s.
